# Final model summary

## Configuration

- **Model:** Random Forest, 24 features, isotonic calibration.
- **Inputs:** 24 Day 30 features. Protected attributes are not inputs: gender, region, highest_education, imd_band, age_band, disability.
- **Parameters:** class_weight=balanced_subsample, max_depth=None, max_features=sqrt, min_samples_leaf=5, min_samples_split=20, n_estimators=234; seed 42.
- **Training presentations:** 2013B, 2013J, 2014B (16,915 rows). **Validation presentation:** 2014J (9,203 rows).
- **Data:** `data/processed/day30_feature_matrix.csv`, SHA-256 `e0c522c15932`.
- **Versions:** python 3.12.10, scikit-learn 1.9.1, pandas 3.0.6, numpy 2.5.3.
- **Inputs used:** `code_module`, `total_clicks`, `active_days`, `avg_clicks_per_active_day`, `clicks_last_7d`, `clicks_prev_7d`, `click_trend`, `first_active_day`, `n_submitted`, `mean_score`, `mean_delay_days`, `n_late`, `weighted_score`, `score_trend`, `n_assessments_due`, `n_missed`, `reg_lead_days`, `registered_late`, `registered_after_cutoff`, `reg_date_missing`, `max_consecutive_inactive_days`, `trailing_inactive_days`, `num_of_prev_attempts`, `studied_credits`.

## Cutoffs

All cutoffs are calibrated scores chosen on out-of-fold predictions for the training presentations (GroupKFold by presentation). 2014J is never used to choose them.

| Cutoff | Rule | Calibrated score | Out-of-fold flagged | Out-of-fold recall | Out-of-fold precision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| top_10 | top 10% of out-of-fold scores | 0.866 | 10.8% | 0.221 | 0.937 |
| top_20 | top 20% of out-of-fold scores | 0.650 | 22.0% | 0.403 | 0.837 |
| top_30 | top 30% of out-of-fold scores | 0.579 | 31.0% | 0.524 | 0.769 |
| wide_net | out-of-fold recall >= 0.80 | 0.333 | 60.1% | 0.802 | 0.608 |

## Risk bands

Defined once in `sar.config.RISK_BANDS`. Each band starts at a named cutoff above.

| Band | Starts at cutoff | Calibrated score range |
|---|---|---|
| Low | none (starts at 0) | 0.000 to below 0.333 |
| Medium | wide_net | 0.333 to below 0.650 |
| High | top_20 | 0.650 to 1 |

## Limitations

- **Fixed cutoffs do not flag a stable share.** At-risk prevalence differs between presentations (0.407 to 0.490), so the top_20 cutoff flags between 17.2% and 28.6% of a held-out presentation, and 17.2% of 2014J. This is why the app flags by capacity ranking.
- **2014J is a validation set, not an untouched test set.** It was used earlier to compare model types. Its figures are therefore somewhat optimistic; the leave-one-presentation-out table shows the spread.
- **Calibration folds.** The calibrator is fitted on out-of-fold scores from models trained on two of the three training presentations, then applied to the model trained on all three.
- **Fairness.** Recall and flag rate differ by gender and age band at the same cutoff (table above), although protected attributes are not inputs.
